prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: closing call-to-action photograph for the OpenFilm landing page. Primary request: Create a quiet, cinematic travel photograph that feels like the final frame on a roll of film. Scene/backdrop: a broad northern beach at blue hour after sunset, low tide reflecting the sky, a distant headland and faint horizon. Subject: one small adult figure seen from behind carrying a folded jacket and walking near the waterline; no face detail. Style/medium: natural editorial 35mm film photography, authentic fine grain, subtle halation, realistic coastal texture. Composition/framing: landscape 3:2, wide negative space through the center for large cream headline text, figure placed low and off-center, strong horizon, enough detail for desktop and mobile crops. Lighting/mood: quiet blue hour, soft residual peach light at the horizon, contemplative, not bleak. Color palette: deep navy, muted slate, pale peach, soft silver reflections. Constraints: photorealistic, natural anatomy, no logos, no readable text, no watermark, no borders, no UI elements. Avoid: dramatic fantasy sky, oversaturation, heavy teal-orange grade, extreme blur, fake film borders, visible brand marks, stock-photo posing.
